pitch2.headline: This is a skills gap. Not a tools gap.
pitch2.body:
48% of non-users name "don't know how to use it effectively" as their primary barrier — not cost, not distrust.

**Productivity gains go almost entirely to people who trained deliberately.** Daily AI users are three times more likely to save four or more hours per week than weekly users. The gap between them isn't the tool. It's structured habit.

This is what AITutoro exists to close.

testimonial.quote: AI won't replace humans — but humans using AI will replace humans who aren't.
testimonial.author: Karim R. Lakhani · Professor, Harvard Business School

pitch.headline: The early-mover window is still open
pitch.body:
35% of the global workforce will need AI-related retraining within three years.

**The window is open.** Non-work AI adoption grew from 36% to 48.7% of US adults in a single year — outpacing workplace adoption.

AI fluency is still a differentiator. That changes fast.
